'''Annalisa Buffa''' (born 14 February 1973)<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Buffa |first=Annalisa |date=October 2022 |title=Short curriculum vitae |url=https://www.epfl.ch/labs/mns/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/cv_buffa_3p.pdf |website=epfl.ch}}</ref> is an Italian mathematician, specializing in [[numerical analysis]] and [[partial differential equation]]s (PDE). She is a professor of mathematics at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPFL]] (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) and holds the Chair of Numerical Modeling and Simulation.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=23 professors appointed at ETH Zurich and EPFL {{!}} ETH-Board |url=https://www.ethrat.ch/en/medien-medienmitteilungen-news/23-professors-appointed-eth-zurich-and-epfl |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210115045039/https://www.ethrat.ch/en/medien-medienmitteilungen-news/23-professors-appointed-eth-zurich-and-epfl |archive-date=15 January 2021 |access-date=29 January 2021 |website=ethrat.ch}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=MNS|url=https://www.epfl.ch/labs/mns/|access-date=29 January 2021|website=epfl.ch|language=en-GB}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Buffa received her master's degree in computer engineering in 1996 and received her PhD in 2000, with supervisor [[Franco Brezzi]], from the [[University of Milan]] with thesis ''Some numerical and theoretical problems in computational electromagnetism''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=177600}}</ref> From 2001 to 2004 she was a Researcher, from 2004 to 2013 a Research Director (rank equivalent to Professor), and from 2013<ref name=":2" /> to 2016 she was the Director at the Istituto di matematica applicata e tecnologie informatiche "E. Magenes" (IMATI) of the [[Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche|CNR]] in [[Pavia]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 April 2016 |title=Cnr, 2,5 milioni di fondi europei per le ricerche della matematica Annalisa Buffa |url=https://www.repubblica.it/scienze/2016/04/19/news/cnr_2_5_milioni_di_fondi_europei_per_le_ricerche_della_matematica_annalisa_buffa-137949632/ |access-date=12 February 2023 |website=[[la Repubblica]] |language=it}}</ref>

In 2016 she was promoted to Full Professor of Mathematics. She holds the Chair of Numerical Modeling and Simulation at [[EPFL]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

She has been a visiting scholar at many institutions, including the {{lang|fr|Laboratoire Jacques-Louis Lions}} at the University of Paris VI, the [[École Polytechnique]], the [[ETH Zürich]], and the [[University of Texas at Austin]] (Institute for Computational Engineering and Sciences, ICES).<ref name=":2" />

==Contributions==
Buffa's research deals with a wide range of topics in PDEs and numerical analysis:<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kovalevsky Lecture 2023: Annalisa Buffa |url=https://awm-math.org/awards/kovalevsky-lectures/kovalevsky-lecture-2023/ |access-date=12 February 2023 |website=Association for Women in Mathematics}}</ref> "isogeometric analysis, fully compatible discretization of PDEs, linear and non linear elasticity, contact mechanics, integral equations on non-smooth manifolds, functional theory for Maxwell equations in non-smooth domains, [[finite element]] techniques for Maxwell equations, non-conforming domain decomposition methods, asymptotic analysis, stabilization techniques for finite element discretizations."<ref>[https://www.epfl.ch/labs/mns/ home page for Annalisa Buffa at EPFL]</ref>

==Recognition==
In 2007 Buffa was awarded the [[Bartolozzi Prize]]. In 2015 she was awarded the {{ill|Collatz Prize|de}} "for her spectacular use of deep and sophisticated mathematical concepts to obtain outstanding contributions to the development of computer simulations in science and industry" (Laudatio).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.imati.cnr.it/index.php/news-3/54-iciam-collatz-prize-awarded-to-annalisa-buffa |title=ICIAM Collatz Prize 2015, news from IMATI |access-date=9 May 2016 |archive-date=10 January 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160110170433/http://www.imati.cnr.it/index.php/news-3/54-iciam-collatz-prize-awarded-to-annalisa-buffa |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2014, she was an Invited Speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Seoul]] with talk ''Spline differential forms''. In 2008, she received an ERC Starting Grant and in 2016 an ERC Advanced Grant. She became a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] in 2016.<ref>{{citation|title=List of members|publisher=Academia Europaea|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Acad_Main/List_of_Members|access-date=2 October 2020}}</ref>
